sentences.text:
The above Writ Petition (C) is filed with the following prayers:
"I. Issue Writ of Certiorari or any other Writ, Order or direction to call for the records leading to Exhibit-P4- Stop Memo issued by the 1st respondent and Quash or Set Aside II.
Issue such other appropriate writ order or direction that may be deemed just and equitable in the facts and circumstances of the case."

[SIC]
2. The petitioner is aggrieved by Ext.P4 stop memo issued by the 1st respondent.
As per Ext.P4, the petitioner was directed to close down the catering service.

sentences.text: This Court admitted the writ petition, and granted an interim order.
I am of the considered opinion that this Writ Petition need not be retained here indefinitely.

If the petitioner has any objection to the stop memo issued by the Panchayat, he can submit his objection, and there can be a direction to consider the same after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and respondents 2 and 3.

Therefore, this Writ Petition is disposed of in the following WP(C) NO.4862 OF 2025 2025:KER:89403 manner:
1. The petitioner is free to submit his objection, if any, against Ext.P4 before the 1 st respondent, within a period of three weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
2.

If such an objection is received, the 1 st respondent will consider the same and pass appropriate orders in it, after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and respondents 2 and 3, as expeditiously as possible, at any rate, within a period of one month from the date of receipt of the objection.
Till then, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner.
3. Based on the order passed, the 1 st respondent will do the needful in accordance with the law.
4. If no objection is filed by the petitioner as directed above, the 1st respondent is free to proceed with Ext.P4 in accordance with the law.
